title: Abakubi b’ebifaananyi by’amayinja
intro: Teebereza embuga ey’amaanyi, erimu ekirabo ky’amaanyi n’obukugu, ng’eyoola ebifo ebinene eby’okubeeramu mu nsozi. Ekibiina kino kyalina obugagga obw’ekitalo n’obukugu obw’enjawulo mu kuzimba. Kyokka, wadde nga baafuna okulabulwa okutegeerekeka obulungi, baalonda ekkubo eryandituusizza ku nkomerero ey’ekitalo era etagenda kwerabirwa. Osobola okuzuula ekibinja kino emboozi yaakyo gy’ekola ng’essomo ery’amaanyi eri bonna abafumiitiriza?
clues: Twaweebwa amaanyi n’obukugu, ne bitusobozesa okuyoola amaka ag’ekitalo butereevu mu nsozi.
Twaweebwa akabonero akategeerekeka okuva eri Allah, ekitonde eky’enjawulo ekyali kigenda okulekebwa nga tekitaataaganyizibwa kuliisa.
Ekitundu kyaffe kyafuuka kya maanyi, nga kisomooza obubaka obw’obwakatonda obwaleetebwa omubaka okuva mu ffe.
Twakola olukwe okutuusa obulabe ku kabonero ak’ekyamagero, wadde nga twalabulwa nti tujja kubonerezebwa okw’amaanyi.
Twajeemera ekiragiro eky’okuleka ekitonde eky’enjawulo okunywa mu luzzi lwaffe ku nnaku ezikyukakyuka.
Twasisinkana enkomerero ey’amaanyi, nga tukubwa wansi okubwatuka okumu, okw’entiisa oluvannyuma lw’ekikolwa kyaffe eky’okusobya.
arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verse: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. (26:158)
